name: Creative credential-harvesting prohibition
description: Prohibits deceptive collection of credentials, payment data, and other sensitive information.
policy: An advertising creative and its destination must not impersonate another organization or use false urgency, false support claims, or misleading interface elements to obtain passwords, authentication codes, payment credentials, government identifiers, recovery phrases, or other sensitive information. A seller that detects deceptive sensitive-data collection must reject the creative and identify this policy.
guidance: Evaluate both the rendered creative and reachable destination. Buyer remediation: remove the deceptive collection flow and direct users only to an authenticated, accurately represented destination controlled by the identified advertiser.

pass.scenario: An ad from a fictional subscription service links to that service's authenticated domain, where an ordinary checkout clearly identifies the merchant and purchase.
pass.explanation: The destination accurately identifies the advertiser and does not deceptively solicit credentials.

fail.scenario: An ad imitates a bank security alert and links to a look-alike domain that asks the user for a password and one-time authentication code.
fail.explanation: The creative impersonates an organization to harvest credentials.
